atoms.a:
Raj picks 7.5 kg of strawberries. It took him 5 hours.

How many kilograms of strawberries did Raj pick in 1 hour?

atoms.b: In 1 hour, Raj picks <mat><gap>1.5</gap></mat> kg of strawberries.

atoms.a: If Raj picks the same amount of strawberries for 8 days, how many kilograms of strawberries will he pick?

atoms.b: Raj will pick <mat><gap>60</gap></mat> kg of strawberries.

atoms.a:
Louise has invited lots of friends to a sleepover party on Saturday. In preparation, she has bought 7 bags of food, each weighing 3,150 g.

How many kilograms of food does she have in total?

atoms.b: Louise has bought <mat><gap>22.05</gap></mat> kg of food.

atoms.a: Assuming the food is shared equally among the 9 friends, how many kilograms will each person eat?

atoms.b: Each person will have <mat><gap>2.45</gap></mat> kg of food.

atoms.a:
Jude is a baker and has prepared 42 kg of dough. Each roll he bakes uses 250 g of dough.

How many rolls can Jude make?

Unfortunately, not many people came into Jude’s bakery that day, and he only sold 124 rolls. The rest will be too stale to sell the next day.

How much dough has been wasted?

atoms.b: <mat><gap>11</gap></mat> kg of dough has been wasted.
